newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 9.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Sri Lanka Army closes camp at Pooneryn in northern mainland and moves troops to strengthen army positions in other areas, say defence sources.
President Chandrika Kumaratunga meets senior government officials on Wednesday to discuss speeding up rehabilitation work in northern Jaffna peninsula.
The United States, Canada and Germany will soon take steps to prevent fund raising by the LTTE, says Justice Minister G.L.Peiris.
Airforce pounds LTTE's "14 base" complex in Nedunkerni jungles in northeastern Mullaitivu district, says Air Force Commander Oliver Ranasinghe.

Police detain 14 people for questioning on suspicion of being members of an LTTE suicide squad after seven hour search in Colombo on Tuesday. Police said a group of 25 suicide bombers from the LTTE had infiltrated Colombo.
